literal: Other than the exalted fame that is peerless in the world, there is not one thing that stands without perishing.
translation: Except for the exalted, peerless fame earned in this world, there is nothing else that remains imperishable.
modern: ஒப்பற்ற இவ்வுலகத்தில் உயர்ந்த புகழைத் தவிர, அழியாமல் நிலைத்து நிற்கக்கூடிய வேறு ஒன்றும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the eternal nature of true fame. In this transient world, everything eventually decays and perishes. The only exception is 'புகழ்' (fame) arising from noble deeds, described here as 'ஒன்றா' (peerless or unequaled). This exalted fame is the sole entity that stands 'பொன்றாது' (undying), outlasting the physical existence of the individual.
